subject: E-Commerce
title: The Last Mile Across Borders
description: A 60-second lesson on The Last Mile Across Borders.

hook.text: Delivery addresses in Japan have no street names. In Brazil, favelas lack formal addresses.

buildup.text: Last-mile delivery depends on local infrastructure: roads, postal systems, delivery culture, and address formats.

discovery.text: What3words assigns unique three-word addresses to every 3-meter square on Earth.

twist.text: The Last Mile Across Borders has a twist: the obvious interpretation usually breaks down.

climax.text: Last-mile delivery that works in the US completely fails in India, Brazil, or Japan. Every market needs local solutions.

punchline.text: No street names in Japan, no addresses in favelas.

quiz.question: Why is last-mile delivery harder in cross-border e-commerce?
options: Address formats, infrastructure, and delivery norms differ by country
